spans.s:
n. (-टं)
The nose.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Disgraced, rejected from a family or race.
m. (-लः)
1 The Bengal mungoose, (Viverra ichneumon.)
2 A proper name, NAKULA, the fourth of the five Pāṇḍu princes.
3 A son.
4 A name of ŚIVA.
f. (-ली)
1 Silk cotton tree.
2 Indian spikenard.
3 A sort of perfume: see शङ्खिनी.
4

Saffron.
5

The letter ह as used in the Tantras.
E.
न not, कुल race or heap, fem. affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Relating or belonging to an ichneumon.
f. (-ली)
1 A plant: the ichneumon plant, a vegetable supposed to furnish the mungoose with an antidote, when bitten in a conflict with a snake, (Serpent ophioxylon?)
2 The root of the Simul tree, (कुक्कुटीकन्द.)
3 A sort of pepper, (Piper chavya.)
E.
नकुल the ichneumon, affixes अण् and ङीष्.

m. (-शः)
1 A Bhairava, an attendant on or emanation from Ś

IVA.
2

The letter ह as used mystically in Tantras.
E.
नकुल, and ईश master.

f. (-ष्टा)
A plant: see रास्ना.
E.
नकुल an ichneumon, and इष्ट wished; the mungoose, if wounded in a conflict with a poisonous snake, is supposed to prevent the effects of the venom by the use of this plant; also नकुलेष्टका.

r. 10th cl. (नक्कयति)
To destroy or annihilate.

m. (-कः)
Heaven, paradise, æther, sky, atmosphere.
E.
न not, with अक derived from क happiness, and the privative अ prefixed, misery; in which there is no unhappiness.

n. (-क्तं)
Night.
E.
नज to be ashamed, तन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 Dirty or ragged cloth.
2 A rag, a wiper, a handkerchief, &c.
E.
नज to be ashamed or modest, affix तन्, and कन् added; also लक्तक.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Going or moving about at night.
m. (-री)
1 A cat.
2 An owl.
3 A goblin.
4 A thief.
E.
नक्त by night, चर to go, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Going at night.
m. (-रः)
1 A goblin, a demon.
2 A tree, the Bdellium tree: see गुग्गुल.
3 An owl.
4 A thief.
E.
नक्तं by night, and चर who goes.

n. (-नं)
Supper.
E.
नक्त night, भोजन food.

ind.
By night, at night.
E.
नज to be ashamed, तन् aff.

m. (-लः)
A tree, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.)
E.
नक्तम् by night, अल to ornament, आङ् prefix, and अच् affix; blossoming at night.

f. (-खा)
Night.
E.
नक्तम् by night, उख to produce, affix क.

n. (-तं)
1 Fasting by day and eating at night.
2 Any religious rite or obligation observed at night.
E.
नक्त, and व्रत vow.

n. (-क्रं)
The upper timber of a door-frame.
nf. (-क्रं-क्रा)
The nose.
f. (-क्रा)
A string of bees or wasps.
m. (-क्रः)
A crocodile.
E.
न not, क्रम to go, affix ड.

m. (-राट्) or नक्रराज (-जः)
A shark, but applied also differently: see ग्राह.
E.
नक्र a crocodile, and राज् or राज king.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A star in general.
2 An asterism in the moon's path or lunar mansion, of which twenty-eight, distinct in name, figure, and number of stars, are enumerated; the Paurānic and popular enumeration of those constellations is twenty-seven; Abhijit, the twenty-seventh, being considered as formed of portions of the two contiguous asterisms, and not distinct from them.
2 A pearl.
E.
णक्ष to go, Uṇādi affix अत्रन् or क्षद Sautra root, to injure, or क्षर to drop, or क्षी to waste or decay, with the negative prefix, and ष्ट्रन् affix; deriv. irr.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms.
n. (-त्रं)
A month, one computed by the moon's passage through the twenty-seven mansions, or of thirty days of sixty Gharis each.
E.
नक्षत्र, and अण् aff.

n. (-क्रं)
1 A particular diagram for astrological calculations.
2 The lunar asterisms collectively.
E.
नक्षत्र, and चक्र a circle.

m. (-मिः)
1 The moon.
2 The pole-star.
3 VIṢṆU.
f. (-मिः)
The last of the asterisms, Revatī, containing thirtytwo stars.
E.
नक्षत्र a star, and नेमि circumference^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

m. (-पः)
The moon.
E.
नक्षत्र, and प who cherishes.

f. (-ला)
1 A necklace containing twenty-seven pearls.
2 The table of the asterisms in the moon's path.
3 A kind of dance.
E.
नक्षत्र a constellation, and माला a garland.

m. (-शः)
1 The moon.
2 Camphor.
E.
नक्षत्र an asterism, and ईश lord.

m. (-थः)
A name of INDRA.
E.
नाक paradise, and नाथ lord; also with कन् added नाकनाथक.

m. (-कः)
INDRA.
E.
नाक, and नायक a chief.

f. (-ता)
A nymph of heaven.
E.
नाक, and वनिता a wife.

m. (-कः)
INDRA.

m. (-सत्)
A deity.
E.
नाक, and सद् who dwells in.

m. (-की)
A deity, a god.
E.
नाक heaven, and इनि aff.

m. (-कुः)
1 An ant or mole hill, a burrow.
2 A mountain.
3 A name of a Muni or saint.
E.
न privative, अक to go, affix उ, or नम to be crooked or bowed, Uṇādi affix उ, and नाक substituted for the radical letters.

n. (-न्ध्यं)
Weakness of sight.
E.
नाकुल, and अन्ध्य blindness.

m. (-द्मा)
A snake.
E.
नाकु a mound of earth, सद्मन् a dwelling.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to the lunar asterisms.
m. (-कः)
A month of twenty-seven days, each day being the period of the moon's passage through a lunar asterism.
f. (-की)
The state or condition to which a person is subjected agreeably to the asterism presiding over his nativity.
E.
नक्षत्र as above, and ठक् aff.
